mapper.sql: l.id, l.lab_code as labCode, l.lab_name as labName, l.building, l.floor, l.room_no as roomNo, l.lab_type as labType, l.capacity, l.manager_user_id as managerUserId, u.real_name as managerName, l.open_status as openStatus, count(d.id) as deviceCount, l.remark, l.created_at as createdAt, l.updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.insert: insert into lab(lab_code, lab_name, building, floor, room_no, lab_type, capacity, manager_user_id, open_status, remark) values(#{labCode}, #{labName}, #{building}, #{floor}, #{roomNo}, #{labType}, #{capacity}, #{managerUserId}, #{openStatus}, #{remark})
mapper.select:
select
from lab l left join sys_user u on u.id = l.manager_user_id left join device d on d.lab_id = l.id where l.id = #{id} group by l.id, l.lab_code, l.lab_name, l.building, l.floor, l.room_no, l.lab_type, l.capacity, l.manager_user_id, u.real_name, l.open_status, l.remark, l.created_at, l.updated_at
mapper.update: update lab set lab_code = #{lab.labCode}, lab_name = #{lab.labName}, building = #{lab.building}, floor = #{lab.floor}, room_no = #{lab.roomNo}, lab_type = #{lab.labType}, capacity = #{lab.capacity}, manager_user_id = #{lab.managerUserId}, open_status = #{lab.openStatus}, remark = #{lab.remark} where id = #{id}
update lab set open_status = #{openStatus}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
